parameters.name: BackupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the backup set. If you specify BackupId, the details of the backup set are returned.

> You can call the [DescribeDataBackups](~~210093~~) operation to query the information about all backup sets of an instance, including backup set IDs.

parameters.name: BackupMode
parameters.description:
The backup mode. Valid values:

*   Automated
*   Manual

If you do not specify this parameter, all backup sets are returned.

parameters.name: BackupStatus
parameters.description:
The state of the backup set. Valid values:

*   Success
*   Failed

If you do not specify this parameter, all backup sets are returned.

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: DataType
parameters.description:
The backup type. Valid values:

*   **DATA**: full backup.
*   **RESTOREPOI**: point-in-time recovery backup.

If you do not specify this parameter, the backup sets of full backup are returned.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

*   30
*   50
*   100

Default value: 30.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb describe-data-backups --db-instance-id gp-bp000000000000000 --backup-id 327329803 --start-time 2011-06-01T15:00Z --end-time 2011-06-01T16:00Z --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --data-type DATA --backup-mode Automated --backup-status Success --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb DescribeDataBackups --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime '2011-06-01T16:00Z' --PageSize 30 --DBInstanceId 'gp-bp000000000000000' --PageNumber 1 --BackupMode Automated --StartTime '2011-06-01T15:00Z' --BackupId 327329803 --DataType DATA --BackupStatus Success
